sample.text:
All numbers on these artboards are SAMPLE values for layout only, not real SoDEX or bot data.

DevOps review 16/11 (applied): route /admin/market-hours, nav "Market hours" right after "Ops" under TEAM; Thin sample = fewer than 3 bot-hours; hot = hour median > 2× that day’s median; markers as VN time + UTC, only "US stock open" is named (21:30, or 20:30 in US summer time, from the real date); calculation text is an on-page disclosure, no external link; tooltips carry the numbers.

Data kept: 1-min candles and bot fills say "Available since {date}" (first real data for that market / bot fills); public-trade markouts say "Kept for 90 days." Sample dates shown: Oct 2 and Oct 20, 2026.

public.text:
Splitting for a public version later:
- Route stays /admin/market-hours (team-only) for now. A public copy would sit in the main nav, with no TEAM section.
- Blocks 1 and 2 are the same for everyone (market data).
- Block 3 is the only per-user part: team sees "DeskLabs bots (real money), all users"; a user sees "Your bots (real money)", built only from their own fills. Same rows, same Thin sample rule.
- Time zone comes from the browser (Intl), with a "Show in UTC" switch. Hour columns are the viewer’s local clock hours, so a +5:30 zone has markers at :30 (e.g. 05:30 · 00:00 UTC). US stock open is computed per real date in America/New_York, then shown in the viewer’s zone.
- Tweak tz / audience on Main to preview any combination.
